acceptance_criteria_draft: one-shot synthetic test evaluation: significantly above identity baseline
not below the protocol first-run global winners (S2X/S2TZX->B9, C3mX->B7) on the same families
any failure -> undetermined, not negative; no test-family iteration

action_space.masking: illegality rules from operator contracts (truncation degeneracy refusal, mask limits, gain overflow) applied as -inf before softmax

explicit_non_reservations: no multi-objective reward structure (lambda_c*cost covers the accuracy/latency trade-off)
five_step_new_family_entry: catalogue version bump with composition-schema review
action-space column extension synced to the frozen catalogue version; old weights keep working (new columns small-constant init)
evaluation-rule coverage for the new family registered in the next tolerance/weights contract version

goodhart_guardrails: reward coefficients stay dB-identity-constructed (=1); never back-fitted from policy training performance
tau_A / tau_D / epsilon update only via mechanism-ladder recalibration (pending: S1/S3), never from training results
identity/oracle anchors evaluated every episode as online calibration of the reward scale
selection-frequency entropy below bound -> diagnose, not judge
test families evaluated once (S5-style); no threshold re-tuning on test

mdp.action: (operator_id, discrete_parameter_tier) or STOP; identity anchor B0_G1_BG always present
mdp.reward_timing: sparse terminal reward; per-stage reward zero
mdp.state: current B-scan (dB scale, fixed size) + EC channels (stage counter t, operator one-hot history)
mdp.transition: deterministic array operators (mean lambda / SVD k / local mean / RPCA lambda axis / gain class)

one_line_definition: per input B-scan, a lightweight policy network selects operator and discrete parameter tier stage by stage from operator_catalogue v0.2 (30 entries + STOP) to maximize the frozen contract reward
prerequisites_before_any_training: B2/B3 sampling design freeze + batch simulation budget
B4 label/reward generation chain acceptance (r1/r2 byte-identical)
C1 PyTorch environment locked (wheel hashes archived, import verified)

reward.hard_constraint_priority: violations clamp R below the identity anchor ("worse than doing nothing")
reward.lambda_c: inference-time knob; switching accuracy/latency mode needs no retrain
reward.weights_contract_note: v0.3 supersedes v0.2 with the background-class section verbatim unchanged (its own supersedes block asserts this); binding to v0.3 is equivalent to the proposal text "权重契约 v0.2" for the background class and additionally covers the gain class

training_method.episode: sample one simulated gather from dev families -> rollout <= t_max stages -> contract reward settlement
training_method.reproducibility: fixed seeds, deterministic operators, r1/r2 double pass; training config frozen as its own contract JSON before any start
